tips.text: Bank Aya before Ember Prime's Resurgence window opens; it never expires.
Buy extra relics for the Blueprint; it is the Rare part and the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine the Rare Blueprint relics to Radiant and leave the Common relics Intact; radshare the Rares.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
